headline: Fund billing/support first: Premium-paywall friction (BIL-PAYWALL) is the largest specific complaint in this sample, with ad load second

recommendations.rationale: BIL-PAYWALL is the largest specific issue by complaints and priority score, and some reports describe a broken purchase flow.
recommendations.title: Fix paywall and purchase-flow friction first

recommendations.rationale: USA-ADS is the second-ranked actionable issue and is closely tied to the free-versus-paid experience.
recommendations.title: Investigate ad load as a secondary item

recommendations.rationale: PLY-WONTPLAY is small but high-severity and is better handled as targeted bug triage than as a quarter-long program.
recommendations.title: Keep playback reliability as a watch item

recommendations.rationale: ACC-LOGIN has few complaints but the highest mean severity, which fits a quick targeted fix.
recommendations.title: Triage login bugs separately
